notes.title: Update - 24.06
notes.notes:
[h2][b]New[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Added first-person camera for some poses during sex (head rotation will be added in the future).
[*]New location - Strip Club. There you can be served by girls.
[*]A new achievement has been added at the same time.
[*]Added a map with search logs. The card itself is located on a bench near the main house.
[/list]

[h2][b]In the process[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]In the future, a new beach location with additional girls and sex scenes will be added.
[*]A save system will be added.
[*]Forest location will be changed
[*]The girls' appearance (clothes, hairstyles) will be improved/replaced.
[*]And also for the search, it is planned to change the location of the girls. Additionally, adding them the ability to move with the main character.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40034635/bfb381d1a46bcf11637bf0cf6204cfba4604b378.png[/img]
Added support for German, Japanese and Spanish

- Fixed bug with HUD after sleep
- Changed interaction with objects. Removed Line Trace. It is enough to be close to the object
- Disabled Motion Blur
- Added the ability to have sex in the first person
